newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering sees significant rise in 98 sales.
newsitem.headline: Schering sees significant rise in 98 sales.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Wednesday that it expected a significant increase in sales from 1998, when the benefits from two takeovers, made last year, will be felt fully.

"The big push in sales will be felt in 1998," when products acquired through the takeovers of Leiras and Jenapharm will be introduced into new markets," Schering chief financial officer Klaus Pohle told a news conference.
Schering however added that it did not plan to grow only through the benefits of takeovers put through its own products, as it had a well filled research pipeline for new products.
For 1997 the group already forecast a 14 percent increase in sales to around six billion marks. Profits are expected to climb between 10 and 15 percent from 1996's 362 million mark profit.
